name: Information Technology Total Services Co., Ltd
summary: Information Technology Total Services Co., Ltd, established in Taipei, Taiwan, in 1999, is a comprehensive provider of technology and business solutions. The company extends its services across Greater China, the Asia Pacific region, and globally, focusing on intelligent application development, extensive IT outsourcing, and business process outsourcing (BPO). Their robust portfolio of SAP solutions encompasses core enterprise resource planning platforms like SAP ERP and S/4HANA, specialized smart manufacturing applications (SAP ME/MII), customer experience management through SAP C/4HANA, and financial planning and consolidation via SAP BPC. They also manage travel and expense with SAP Concur, offer business intelligence and predictive analytics, manage data archiving, provide field service management, develop ABAP customizations, and perform SAP system upgrades and maintenance. Beyond SAP, ITTS delivers innovative IoT-driven smart services for various industries, including intelligent manufacturing, smart catering, and smart transportation. Their IT infrastructure consulting includes integrated computing solutions like Cisco UCS, strategic IT architecture planning, and outsourced IT maintenance services. Additionally, the company's BPO division handles a range of tasks, from call center operations and system implementation to document management services such as billing statement processing, envelope sealing, format printing, and mailing outsourcing. Cloud services are also a significant offering. ITTS serves a diverse clientele across numerous sectors, including governmental bodies, financial institutions, manufacturing, high-technology firms, telecommunications providers, logistics companies, and retail businesses.
